Committee: State Government

Date: 02/17/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 136 as introduced would increase the obligations of various state or local entities by an undetermined amount to maintain signs or markers designating the Dauphin Island Sea Lab's Alabama Aquarium as the official Aquarium of Alabama.
Chris Pringle, Chair
State Government
